title: Introducing t0-gamma
summary: Our new open-weights forecasting foundation model ranks first among time-series foundation models on GIFT-Eval, fev-bench and TIME.
body_markdown:
**t0-gamma is our new forecasting foundation model.** It has a similar architecture to[t0-beta](https://www.theforecastingcompany.com/blog/t0-beta/) , which our[technical report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24559) describes in detail. It strengthens the t0 family’s ability to forecast from target history, related series and inputs known ahead of time. Weeks after the release of t0-beta, t0-gamma achieves state-of-the-art performance on public benchmarks. At the time of release, it ranks first among time-series foundation models on GIFT-Eval, fev-bench and TIME.


[Hugging Face ↗](https://huggingface.co/theforecastingcompany/t0-gamma)[tfc-t0 on GitHub ↗](https://github.com/theforecastingcompany/tfc-t0)[t0 tech report ↗](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24559)


## Number one among time-series foundation models


At the time of release, t0-gamma is the top time-series foundation model on all three public benchmarks we track. On[fev-bench](https://huggingface.co/spaces/autogluon/fev-bench) , it reaches a **49.42% skill score** and a **91.6% win rate** . On[GIFT-Eval](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Salesforce/GIFT-Eval) , it scores **0.4520 CRPS** and **0.6608 MASE** . On[TIME](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Real-TSF/TIME-leaderboard) , it scores **0.5340 CRPS** and **0.6370 MASE** .


The same checkpoint is used everywhere, with no task-specific retraining.

Leading five single zero-shot models on each benchmark, plus t0-beta below the dashed line; # is the rank among those models. Bars show the headline metric. GIFT-Eval and TIME scores are geometric means normalized to seasonal naive, recomputed from the public results with each leaderboard’s own method and matching t0-gamma’s submitted scores. fev-bench skill and win rate come from` fev.leaderboard` on the benchmark’s results, where t0-gamma is also first of all 30 entries. Excludes agents, ensembles and fine-tuned systems: on GIFT-Eval several agents score higher, as does TimeRSI, an agent built on TimesFM-3, on TIME. GIFT-Eval’s default view sorts by mean per-configuration rank, where t0-gamma is second to TimesFM-3.


t0-gamma leads this comparison across all three benchmarks with a single checkpoint you can download and run. We focus on time-series foundation models: the forecasting engines developers can build on directly. Agent systems add task-specific orchestration around those engines and form a separate category, detailed in the figure notes above.


### Head to head on individual tasks


An aggregate score can hide where a model wins. On fev-bench, **t0-gamma beats Chronos-2 on 74 of 100 tasks** . Against TimesFM-3, it wins 54 tasks overall: an even split on the 42 tasks with covariates and 56.9% of the rest.

The weakest columns point at the next step. The Toto-2.0 models remain competitive on tasks without covariates, and TimesFM-3 holds its own on tasks with them.


### A clear step up from t0-beta


t0-gamma improves on t0-beta on every benchmark, with the same leaderboards and the same scoring. On fev-bench, it beats t0-beta on 83 of 100 tasks.

## Run it


The[t0-gamma weights are on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/theforecastingcompany/t0-gamma) . Our open-source library,[tfc-t0](https://github.com/theforecastingcompany/tfc-t0) , runs them locally in a few lines of Python.


```text
pip   install   "tfc-t0[torch]>=0.6.0"
```


The[quickstart](https://github.com/theforecastingcompany/tfc-t0#-quickstart) walks you through a first forecast with t0-gamma, with and without covariates.


For managed forecasting, the[Retrocast API](https://docs.retrocast.com/api-v1/contents/intro) and[Retrocast](https://app.retrocast.com/) forecast and backtest your own series without running a model yourself.


**For enterprise deployments, larger forecasting workloads, or help evaluating t0-gamma on your own data,[talk to us](https://www.theforecastingcompany.com/contact/) .** And if you’d like to build the next one,[we’re hiring](https://www.theforecastingcompany.com/company/#roles) .
